description: This source file defines several classes related to transaction attribution grains within the Orleans framework, including various attributes for attribution handling and a static helper class for nested transaction ID retrieval.

classes.name: NoAttributionGrain
classes.description: Implements attribution behavior where no attribution is performed.

classes.name: CreateOrJoinAttributionGrain
classes.description: Handles creating or joining attribution contexts.

classes.name: NotAllowedAttributionGrain
classes.description: Represents a scenario where attribution is not allowed.

classes.name: AttributionGrain
classes.description: Static utility class for retrieving nested transaction IDs considering transaction context.

methods.name: GetNestedTransactionIds
methods.description: Retrieves nested transaction IDs for a given tier and tiers array, recursively called within various attribution grains and the static helper.
